head_commit.message:
[ipa-delivery:838] Build the private RewindBox IPA 838: MeloNX Core f2678122 and MoltenVK with the Metal memory census

Base 837 (run 45469657832, receipt 96ec453a): DeSmuME and Azahar of collection 14954690166 kept.
- MoltenVK (rebuild pin a53074c44, run 45466266941, binary 4887c9b7):
  - tenth part: a Metal render pipeline state shared by pipelines whose Metal descriptors are
    identical; cull, depth and stencil stay applied per pipeline;
  - eleventh part: one line of MoltenVK's performance summary that counts Metal memory (heaps,
    resident textures and buffers, aliases, descriptor pool and visibility buffers, the rest).
    Measurement only.
- MeloNX Core f2678122 (run 45471263838, packaged fingerprint e06d7124): the code arena journal
  lines are readable (on IPA 833 the journal's secret filter redacted all of them).
Images that must change: MeloNXCore, MeloNXMoltenVKStandalone and Runner; 48 retained. Promoted
from the base line: 3a18f778c, 1d413b0a5, a5b08812c, 03394eb5d and 6c1accd83. Nothing measured
on an iPhone.
